scope: Six fictional briefs, one run each; no existing user project modified; no payment calls.

requirements.sourceQuote: No horizontal scrolling at viewport width 390 px.
requirements.label: No horizontal overflow at 390px viewport

runs.brief: Make the landing page mobile friendly and add a booking button.

requirements.sourceQuote: Make the landing page mobile friendly
requirements.label: Mobile friendly view
ambiguities: How should mobile friendly be reviewed and tested by both parties?

requirements.label: Booking button link destination
ambiguities: What is the destination URL or link for the booking button?

issues: Mobile friendliness lacks an unresolved viewport question.

runs.brief: Make it feel premium, calm and trustworthy, using our brand style.

requirements.sourceQuote: Make it feel premium, calm and trustworthy, using our brand style.

limits: Small six-brief sample; semantic coverage assessed against reviewed fixture expectations.
Accepted outputs pass the application validator; rejected provider output is unavailable through this endpoint.
No live PayPal transaction is part of this evaluation.
freeTierConfirmation: User confirmed unbilled Free Tier; local confirmation gate enabled. API key does not independently prove billing tier.
